Her relationship with her mom is complicated, but they know they can rely on each other when trouble like this comes. Jade can craft magic bullets and enchant weapons and clothes to help defend her ranch from villains like Níyol. Níyol of the Mąʼiitsoh Tribe Níyol is the coyote you're assigned to capture. She's pretty playful, Invasively curious, and will strip you bare mid combat. What a freak! Her strange wind powers will make catching her more difficult than it sounds. His special attunement with nature allowed him to obtain animal features not fitting of his coyote demi-human heritage and granted him a special relationship with the wind. He fathers Níyol with the wind as his wife. That's Níyol's story anyway. Trigger Warnings Sexual Harassment may happen to your character. There is minor nudity.
